identifier.value: Rollstack Automated Slide Decks and Documents

product.name: Rollstack Automated Slide Decks and Documents
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automatically creates and updates slide decks and documents by connecting to BI and analytics tools, embedding visualizations, and scheduling updates.

product.name: Rollstack AI-Powered Data Analysis
product.description: An AI feature that analyzes embedded data and visualizations in presentations and documents to generate contextual insights and summaries for decision-making.

identifier.value: Rollstack Scaled Content Generation with Templates

product.name: Rollstack Scaled Content Generation with Templates
product.description: A tool to create and automate multiple variants of presentations and documents at scale using templates connected to live data sources.

product.name: Rollstack Report Distribution and Sharing
product.description: A built-in functionality to automatically distribute updated presentations and documents via email or communication platforms like Slack.

product.name: Rollstack Data Source Integrations
product.description: Connectors that link popular business intelligence and analytics tools like Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Metabase, and Google Sheets to presentation and document platforms for automated data updates.

product.name: Rollstack Governance and Security Features
product.description: Platform features that provide role-based access control, user permissions, single sign-on, and local data storage to ensure secure and compliant data-driven reporting.
